title: 第二十五章 一路杀下去第二十六章 气血无双灭杀怨灵
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 砰砰砰！
就在这时，楼梯区域传来沉闷声音。
两位装备着机械臂铠的洋人秘武高手，快速从一楼区域，冲了进来，眼瞳一缩，看到了二楼一幕。
他们发出大喝，直接向着林玄这边直冲而来，上来就是一掌向着林玄那边狂抓而去。
似乎根本不在乎林玄手中那貌美女子的死活。
“不要！快退下！！！”
貌美女子惊恐大叫。
自己是伯爵夫人！！！
自己的性命更重要！！！
然而两位洋人高手，根本没有搭理，反而手掌更加快速，在机械蒸汽的加持下，发出尖锐刺耳呼啸，五根手指比鹰爪还要尖锐，比虎爪还要凶残。
这是真正的合金！
无坚不摧！
林玄眉头一皱，身躯一闪，好似残影一样，快到不可思议。
从这两人的爪击中快速躲闪开来。
两人一击不中，反应极快，手臂中发出嘶嘶的声音，身后的蒸汽阀门在不断冒出滚滚热气，速度更快，只顾向着林玄的残影狂抓而去。
他们眼神冰冷，又快又狠。
根本不在乎会不会伤到貌美女子分毫。
他们只忠于伯爵。
其他人全部不理。
貌美女子在林玄手中在不断惨叫，惊恐到极致。
突然！
林玄身躯一闪，出现在一位洋人高手身后，手掌蕴含无尽劲力，猛然间一掌拍下。
咔嚓！
砰！
恐怖劲力带着独特的穿透性，好似诡异钢针，一下子将那洋人身后背的蒸汽阀门震得凹陷，冒出大片白色蒸汽。
随后恐怖的劲力依旧还在震荡，直接钻入对方体内，破坏他的五脏，使他上来喷出一口血水，夹杂着内脏碎片，身躯直接前扑出去，砸在地上，当场惨死。
另一位洋人眼瞳一缩，依旧还在挥动双手，继续向着林玄那边快速抓去。
林玄一掌打死一人后，心中已然有底。
他们的机械臂铠确实厉害。
但是这两人的实力太弱。
哪怕有机械臂铠的加持，他们的实力也最多相当于暗劲巅峰。
至于自身防御？
那更是不堪一击！！！
砰！
林玄抓住机会，又是一掌打出，将第二位装备机械臂铠的洋人给打的狂吐血水，横飞出去，内脏尽碎，惨死非命。
林玄走上前去，抓起对方的机械臂铠，轻轻一扯。
content_en:
Bang bang bang!
At this moment, a dull sound came from the stair area.
Two foreign secret martial arts masters equipped with mechanical gauntlets quickly rushed in from the first floor area. Their pupils shrank and they saw the scene on the second floor.
They shouted loudly and rushed towards Lin Xuan. When they came up, they grabbed Lin Xuan with their palms.
It seemed that he didn't care at all about the life or death of the beautiful woman in Lin Xuan's hands.
"No! Get out of here!!!"
The beautiful woman screamed in fear.
She is a countess! ! !
Your own life is more important! ! !
However, the two foreign masters did not pay attention at all. Instead, their palms moved faster. With the blessing of mechanical steam, they made a sharp and piercing roar. The five fingers were sharper than eagle claws and more cruel than tiger claws.
This is real alloy!
Indestructible!
Lin Xuan frowned and his body flashed, like an afterimage, incredibly fast.
Quickly dodge from the claws of these two people.
The two of them missed a hit, reacted very quickly, and there was a hissing sound in their arms. The steam valve behind them was constantly emitting hot steam, and they were faster, just grabbing at Lin Xuan's afterimage.
Their eyes were cold, fast and cruel.
He didn't care at all whether he would hurt the beautiful woman at all.
They were loyal only to the count.
Everyone else ignored it.
The beautiful woman kept screaming in Lin Xuan's hands, terrified to the extreme.
Sudden!
Lin Xuan's body flashed and he appeared behind a foreign master. His palm contained endless power and he suddenly struck it with a palm.
Click!
Bang!
The terrifying power had unique penetrating properties, like a strange steel needle, which suddenly dented the steam valve on the foreigner's back, releasing a large amount of white steam.
Then the terrifying force was still trembling, and it penetrated directly into the opponent's body, destroying his internal organs, causing him to come up and spit out a mouthful of blood, mixed with internal organ fragments, and his body rushed forward, hitting the ground, and died tragically on the spot.
The other foreigner's pupils shrank, but he was still waving his hands and continued to grab Lin Xuan quickly.
After Lin Xuan killed one person with one palm, he already felt confident.
Their mechanical arm armor is really powerful.
But the strength of these two people is too weak.
Even with the blessing of mechanical arm armor, their strength is at most equivalent to the peak of Anjin.
As for self-defense?
That is even more vulnerable! ! !
Bang!
Lin Xuan seized the opportunity and struck out with another palm, beating the second foreigner equipped with the mechanical arm armor until he vomited blood and flew away. His internal organs were shattered and he died miserably.
Lin Xuan stepped forward, grabbed the opponent's mechanical arm armor, and pulled it gently.
